info.title: API.SH: Sweetwater
info.description: The Sweetwater API from API.SH: public Sweetwater data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sweetwater-articles

get.description:
Products across Sweetwater's catalog with brand, category path, price range, in-stock, condition and any product facet (`facets`, e.g. Body Shape:Stratocaster;Number of Frets:22), sorted by relevance, price, rating, newest, popularity or brand: name, brand, link, price, list price, rebates, condition, stock and incoming stock, free shipping, rating and reviews, categories, image and financing, with the total and every facet's value counts for the result. Up to 100 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sweetwater-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words. Optional when a filter is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path, e.g. Guitars > Electric Guitars.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Facet filters as Name:Value;Name:Value (several values: Name:A|B). Names and values come from `facets` in a response.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Used gear listed on Sweetwater's Gear Exchange: title, brand, condition, price, original price and price drops, offers accepted, shipping cost, local pickup, the seller's city and member-since year, decade made, category and image, with brand, condition and price filters and facet counts. The seller's name and rating come with /sweetwater/v1/used-listing. Up to 100 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sweetwater-used

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Gear Exchange listing by id or link: title, brand, condition, price, original price and price drops, offers accepted, shipping, local pickup, decade made, category, image and the seller (the name it lists under, storefront id and link, rating and rating count, town, member-since year, return days). Sold or removed listings answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sweetwater-used-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (the number at the start of the listing link) or link. Required unless latest=true.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true = the newest listing (optionally matching q).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
